speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are experiencing agitation and have noticed a yellowish coloring in your skin and eyes; have you been feeling any pain in your right upper abdomen or experiencing dark urine recently?

speaker: Patient
text: 20-year-old male. The patient was previously healthy and has been brought to the emergency department due to agitation over the past 24 hours. Family members have noticed a yellowish coloring of his skin and eyes over the past week. The patient has a history of occasional cocaine and ecstasy use, and drinks alcohol socially on weekends. The patient also admits to high-risk sexual behaviors without using appropriate protection.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Hepatitis (likely Hepatitis C given high-risk sexual history, though drug-induced or acute viral hepatitis remain differentials). The patient's agitation is likely a symptom of severe jaundice or early hepatic encephalopathy. Immediate liver function tests, viral serologies, and coagulation profile are required for confirmation.
